|colspan="6" align="left"|<small>'''Notes:'''</small><br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|reward|<small>1</small>}} <small>Sokka and Bokor initially placed 1st and 2nd respectively. However, both Sokka and Takéo were disqualified after one of their<br />members failed to pass an obstacle properly. Therefore, only Bokor won reward.</small><br />
{{note|elim|<small>2</small>}} <small>After losing the reward challenge, Bokor competed in an elimination challenge, where one casataway would be eliminated. Maria<br />lost the challenge and was eliminated.</small><br />
{{note|ambassadors|<small>3</small>}} <small>At the ambassadors meeting, Mathilde and Sandro agreed to eliminate Yassin.</small><br />
{{note|pairs|<small>4</small>}} <small>Kelly was Corentin's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore he was eliminated with her at Tribal Council.</small><br />
{{note|idol|<small>5</small>}} <small>A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.</small><br />
{{note|final4|<small>6</small>}} <small>At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Mathilde came in last and was eliminated.</small>
{{refend}}
